card.name: Needle entry into vial stopper
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "through" or "on" just before the model would name a vial stopper, cap, lid or closure. Seen in preparation steps where a needle goes into a vial or a container is closed or hung.

modes.label: Needle through stopper
modes.description: The word before "center" or "stopper" when a needle is inserted into a vial.

modes.label: Container closure or hanging hole
modes.description: A linking word before a closure, cap or hole on an IV bag or bottle.
modes.example: Hang container using hole<< on>> the lower flap.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like lid, top and seal, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on little words right before the text names the stopper, cap or lid of a vial or container.
